title: Quiz Competition Organised by Department of Legal Affairs under Special Campaign 6 and Swachhata Hi Seva 2026
body_text:
As part of Special Campaign 6 and Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 , the Department of Legal Affairs, Ministry of Law and Justice , organised a Quiz Competition at Kartavya Bhavan-2, New Delhi , on September 30, 2026.
The Quiz Competition was organised with the objective of promoting awareness and active participation among officials and staff on issues relating to cleanliness, sanitation, environmental sustainability, and responsible management of waste and water resources .
The competition provided participants with an engaging platform to test and enhance their knowledge of various aspects of cleanliness and sustainable practices. It also sought to encourage greater awareness and individual responsibility towards adopting environmentally conscious practices in the workplace and in the community.
The initiative reaffirmed the Department's commitment to the objectives of Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 and Special Campaign 6 , with emphasis on fostering a culture of cleanliness, sustainability and responsible resource management.
